key: I'm sorry, please don't bother me right now.
en: I'm sorry, please don't bother me right now.
ja: ごめんなさい　今は　話しかけないで

key: I'm trying to think of a way to get out of here since the elevator is offline.
en: I'm trying to think of a way to get out of here since the elevator is offline.
ja: エレベーターが　止まってて　ここから出る方法を　考えてるの

key: My friend sent word to me a bit ago, but just afterwards, all these plants took over, and I haven't been able to reply, or even leave.
en: My friend sent word to me a bit ago, but just afterwards, all these plants took over, and I haven't been able to reply, or even leave.
ja: 少し前に　友達から　連絡が来たのに　その直後に　草木が　あふれ出して　返事も　外に出ることも　できないの

key: She said I could stay with her, but how can I if I can't even--
en: She said I could stay with her, but how can I if I can't even--
ja: うちに　来ていいって　言ってくれたのに　これじゃ——

key: How did you even get here? Are the elevators back online?!
en: How did you even get here? Are the elevators back online?!
ja: どうやって　ここまで来たの? エレベーターが　動いたの!?

key: Thank goodness, I'll go right away!
en: Thank goodness, I'll go right away!
ja: よかった　すぐに　行くわ!

key: Feel free to drop by my friend's house in Peridot if you want to talk!
en: Feel free to drop by my friend's house in Peridot if you want to talk!
ja: 話したくなったら　ペリドットの　友達の家に　寄ってね!
